set.body:
Follow-ups from the cold reviews of common-pipeline slices 2a/2b (landed). None blocked landing.
1. OWNER DECISION: NotAssessed is not neutral in the HSMM cost model. ExternalStates.natural = None means every named external state costs externalFloor + externalMismatch and none sits at the floor (cost.scala ~1197, strictcost.scala ~227), biasing such a unit toward anchoring; and contentcost.scala:58-62 lets it fall through the wildcard to the predicate-less default level. Unreachable today (no path feeds supplied units to a cost model). Candidate fix: all named externals at the floor; explicit granularity-missing.
2. ExpressedUncertainty has no "not assessed" value; supplied units carry Unmarked though no hedge detector ran (PreparedRecall.scala).
3. interview: NotAssessed -> UnitClass.Uninterpretable -> ClassifiedUninterpretable, indistinguishable from a truly uninterpretable unit (induce.scala ~185). Unreachable today.
4. TimedSourceView: level-2 nodes are ranked by ordinal, so with film-numbered collections the cartoon intros rank last although first/seventh in time (TimedSourceView.scala ~228).
5. PreparedRecall: equals ignores the graph; Segmentation.kind is a String (rule 2); boundary probes for copy/apply are shape-only; fromProduct/Mirror not probed.
6. StudyReplay: a reply containing NaN is accepted by Python and refused by the Scala parser (fails closed). The reply contract's field names are hard-coded; a study with other judgements needs them in the export.
7. ff_export_run.py has no unit test of its own; compare_replies.py does not compare condition/manifestSha256.
8. KM annotation fails in ff_gold.load_dictionary (int('')) - pre-existing, unchecked.
set.title: Common pipeline follow-ups (slices 2a/2b): NotAssessed neutrality in the cost model [owner decision], uncertainty not-assessed, misc
